svg.title: Render check in a limited child process
svg.desc: The executor's container, 640 Mi of memory and 500m of CPU, holds the executor and at most one render process. The executor validates the input of semdiff.Check, waits for the one render slot and starts its own binary again with one fixed argument and an empty environment, then reads the render process's resident size every millisecond on Linux and kills it past 192 MiB. The render process sets its limits before it reads any input: 20 s of CPU time, 384 MiB of data mappings on Linux (a partial guard: the Go runtime's heap mappings pass it unchecked), 128 MiB of Go memory sampled every millisecond, and an OOM score adjustment of 1000. It writes a ready line, reads the input as JSON on stdin, renders before and after the change and writes one answer on stdout. The executor reads three kinds of end. An answer: a result, or a refusal with a known reason and a detail cut at 2 KiB. A TooLarge refusal: the render process's own exit at the memory sampling or the CPU limit, the executor's kill at the resident limit when the process ended by that SIGKILL, or the fifth end in a row without an answer for the same request and plan. An error for a retry: no ready line; a kill by a signal the executor did not send such as an OOM killer's, the Go runtime's out of memory exit, any other crash or an unreadable answer, which the executor counts; or the step's context ending, which kills the process and is not counted. Before it starts the render process the executor marks the request in its status (status.unfinishedRenders, a count per plan digest) and removes the mark when the check returns, so a render that takes the whole container down is counted across restarts: after 3 unfinished renders in a row of the same plan the request ends in NeedsIntervention with reason RenderNeverFinished and no further render starts. The render process has no token in its environment and reads only its stdin. Memory: 230.4 MiB for the executor, 192 MiB for the render process and a 128 MiB margin make 550.4 MiB of the 640 Mi; on cgroup v2 a container OOM ends both processes.
svg.text: Container 640Mi: executor 230.4 MiB, render process 192 MiB, margin 128 MiB.
